notes.notes:
Calling all Deepweb enthusiasts!

Deepweb Simulator invites you to join our exclusive developer stream for Steam Next Fest (June 10 - 17)!

Catch us live on June 11 at 2:00 AM (UTC) to get a sneak peek of the upcoming content. 

We'll be in the chat and will answer your questions and listen to your advice!

Join our Discord server:https://discord.gg/8SmR7q8s
